title: Surinam: Cimarrones, diversidad asiática y convivencia políglota
goal: Evaluate Suriname's unique ethnic mosaic (Maroons, Hindustanis, Javanese, Creoles), the Sranantongo creole language, and religious coexistence in Paramaribo.
grammar: Historia y diversidad comunitaria de Surinam

sections.title: Unit 9: The Guianas & Belize — Lesson 3
body: Welcome to lesson 3 of Unit 9 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Belize, Suriname & The Guianas: Multilingual Frontiers.
In this lesson, we study surinam: cimarrones, diversidad asiática y convivencia políglota, evaluating physical geomorphology, maroon resistance, linguistic pluralism, and geopolitics.

items: Evaluate Suriname's unique ethnic mosaic (Maroons, Hindustanis, Javanese, Creoles), the Sranantongo creole language, and religious coexistence in Paramaribo.
Master the lexicon and discourse of surinam-cimarrones-mosaico-etnico.
